description: This file defines the ArtifactClient class used to interact with the AWS Artifact service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as retrieving reports, account settings, and agreements, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: ArtifactClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Artifact service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: getAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves AWS Artifact account settings.

methods.name: getTermForReport
methods.description: Retrieves information about a term for a report.

methods.name: getTermForReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves info about a term for a report.

methods.name: putAccountSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates AWS Artifact account settings.
